statement: The nonempty package tree preserves the original postorder identity sequence.

adapter.mapping: The nonempty package tree preserves the original postorder identity sequence. Its original receiver and direct outcome are indexed in controls/table.json.

notes: Node is initialized first on the original subject JVM. It reads LF as line.separator and initializes 14 additional application types, each compared with its state when initialized alone. The printer configuration and data-key objects are unheld and a read of those static fields stops the checker. Tree constructors, observers, traversal, ordering and identity use their original bytecode.
